children: Old Dominion reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $1.59 billion, up 13.1% from a year earlier, and diluted earnings per share of $1.65, up 28.9%. Operating income increased 25.4% to $452.6 million, while net income rose 26.9% to $343.7 million. The company’s operating ratio improved to 71.5% from 74.3%.
Revenue was $1.59 billion for the quarter, a 13.1% increase year over year.
Operating income rose 25.4% to $452.6 million; the operating ratio improved 280 basis points to 71.5%.
Diluted earnings per share were $1.65, up 28.9% from $1.28 in the third quarter of 2025.
For the first nine months of 2026, revenue increased 6.9% to $4.48 billion and diluted earnings per share rose 19.5% to $4.47.
On-time service was 99% in the quarter, and the claims ratio was 0.1%.
LTL tons per day decreased 0.1% year over year as shipments per day fell 2.0% and weight per shipment increased 1.9%; tons per day rose year over year in September.
The company cited improved demand during the quarter and continued its focus on yield management.
Planned 2026 capital spending includes investments in real estate and service center expansion, tractors and trailers, and information technology and other assets.
